answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The hollow holds work receipts rather than names, so the quartz of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
